live_verification.limits: Observed-prefix coordinates and exact issue-time coverage are covered by Rust causal/mixed-window tests, not reconstructed from decimated reports. Primitive at-action windows only; no full consequence score or action-time adoption.

runtime_contract.configuration: temporal_action_profiles.file and lowercase sha256; requires temporal_body_prototypes and temporal_phrase
runtime_contract.validation: 32 MiB bound, SHA-256, schema/dimensions, physical grid, body model version, medoid order/mask/f64 descriptor bits, class/time bindings, finite values and masks
runtime_contract.loaded_profile: one immutable Arc shared by both workers; no file read or table allocation when temporal mode is off
runtime_contract.assignment: existing <=0.25 standardized shared-group gate; descriptors transfer between matching groups, without pitch/gain/rate interpolation
runtime_contract.storage: fixed 8*7*32 optional primitive window cells per bus; refreshed with shared assignment snapshot; retirement masks apply immediately
runtime_contract.time: action_at and evaluation_at separate API arguments; normal preview currently evaluates at action_at under existing specification
runtime_contract.window: last 2 s or group age; actual available prefix followed by conditional projected physical frames
runtime_contract.boundary: first-hop rise/decline recomputed from adjacent observed log RMS; first-hop flux unsupported
runtime_contract.background: held issue-time energy inferred from observed own energy/share; zero-own/zero-share stays unknown; stored explicitly per cell
runtime_contract.coverage: issue-time ordinal coverage frozen; observed and projected window coverage remain separate
runtime_contract.report: profile hash, model identity, group identities, clocks, memory sizes, cell/support counts and latest cell of each class
runtime_contract.ui: primitive window and projected coordinate counts; explicit uncalibrated at-action label
